systems.tiers: national online channel, launched in late 2024, for requesting birth, marriage, affiliation and death certificates, land, commercial and vehicle certificates, criminal records and identity card renewal without visiting a conservatória; 905 acts by 16 December 2025, of which 290 birth and 22 death certificates

note: A portal for requesting copies of acts, an alternative to the conservatória counters; it does not register events, and the page says nothing of how the conservatórias make the record.
